name: DWARFLAB Dwarf 3
sources: agent/reference/dwarf3-specs.md (official product page and manual; QE 83%, read noise 0.6 e⁻ minimum, full well 11 270 e⁻, 12-bit, black ≈ 200)
dark master 120 s / gain 60 / 40 °C of this unit: median 168 ADU (2026-10-23)
conversion gain ≈ 0.25 e⁻/ADU at gain 60: single-frame noise of a 60 s M 31 sub of this unit (2026-10-21; estimate)
exposure choices: sessions on this unit at 15, 30, 60 and 120 s (EQ) and 15 s alt-az; tele astro gain range 40–240 (device schema)
dither: every 6 subs below 60 s and every 10 from 60 s, the dithered sub discarded (DWARFLAB troubleshooting guide; session gaps of this unit)
notes: The firmware refuses a deep-sky exposure without a dark master of that exposure and gain (-11503): the plan only recommends covered pairs when the dark list is known.
How e⁻/ADU scales with the Dwarf's gain number is assumed (inverse-proportional): measure each gain you use.
